scope: Stage 5 external-I/O ownership ledger; this is evidence, not a runtime provider selector

roles.health_owner: Brain health composition using the selected bridge
roles.errors: HomeAssistantBridgeHttpError, HomeAssistantBridgeUnreachableError, HomeAssistantBridgeServiceError
roles.cache_owner: home-automation entity registry and UI snapshot owners; bridge owns no cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical home_assistant domain provider selection and credential handle

roles.health_owner: house UI request boundary; no independent readiness role
roles.errors: camera proxy unavailable and web-boundary HTTP errors
roles.cache_owner: house UI snapshot cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical home_assistant provider plus curated camera definitions

roles.health_owner: music health delegates Plex session/readiness mechanics to the bridge
roles.errors: MusicBridgeConfigurationError and MusicBridgeError codes
roles.cache_owner: music domain; bridge owns no cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical music provider role and typed Plex connection

roles.owner: media proxy and satellite playback control plane
roles.health_owner: media request edge and satellite control health
roles.errors: web-boundary media errors and typed control-plane failures
roles.cache_owner: satellite playback authority; no provider cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical music connection and playback-target registry

roles.health_owner: audiobook health delegates provider mechanics to the bridge
roles.errors: AudiobookBridgeConfigurationError and AudiobookBridgeError codes
roles.cache_owner: audiobook domain and satellite long-form authority; bridge owns no cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical audiobook provider role, user mapping, and typed connection

roles.health_owner: media request edge; audiobook health remains domain-owned
roles.errors: AudiobookBridgeError mapped to HTTP only by media routes
roles.cache_owner: no proxy cache; provider and satellite retain their own state
roles.configuration_authority: canonical audiobook provider and authenticated playback selection

roles.health_owner: calendar domain
roles.errors: CalendarBridgeConfigurationError and CalendarBridgeError codes
roles.cache_owner: calendar domain snapshot/cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical calendar provider role, account/calendar mapping, and credential handle

roles.health_owner: news domain
roles.errors: NewsBridgeConfigurationError and NewsBridgeError codes
roles.cache_owner: news domain response cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical news provider role and curated RSS feeds

roles.health_owner: facts domain availability; no separate remote health endpoint
roles.errors: FactsProviderResult provider_error status and typed retrieval detail
roles.cache_owner: facts domain cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical facts provider role and typed static or Wikipedia definition

roles.health_owner: weather domain station health
roles.errors: WeatherStationBridgeConfigurationError and WeatherStationBridgeError codes
roles.cache_owner: weather current/history domain caches
roles.configuration_authority: canonical weather station provider role and station definition

roles.health_owner: weather domain forecast health
roles.errors: WeatherForecastBridgeConfigurationError and WeatherForecastBridgeError codes
roles.cache_owner: weather forecast domain cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical weather forecast provider role and location coordinates

roles.health_owner: weather request boundary; no independent readiness role
roles.errors: weather remote lookup unavailable/no-result responses
roles.cache_owner: weather remote geocode and observation caches
roles.configuration_authority: canonical weather remote settings and fixed provider endpoints

roles.health_owner: network domain
roles.errors: immutable observation status/detail rather than provider exceptions
roles.cache_owner: network domain status cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical network inventory and probe definitions

roles.health_owner: network domain
roles.errors: immutable monitoring observation status/detail
roles.cache_owner: network domain status cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical LibreNMS adapter definition and credential handle

roles.health_owner: network domain readiness and postcondition checks
roles.errors: immutable PlatformActionOutcome and PlatformObservation values consumed and shaped by network policy
roles.cache_owner: network domain cooldown and runbook state; adapters own no policy cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical network adapters, inventory, policy, and credential handles

roles.health_owner: notification channel health
roles.errors: AppriseBridgeError codes and delivery receipt failure detail
roles.cache_owner: notifications durable receipt owner; bridge owns no cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical notification provider role, recipient tags, and gateway URL

roles.health_owner: Suggestions diagnostics and bounded run result
roles.errors: OpenClaw adapter and normalized advisory failure results
roles.cache_owner: Suggestions storage owns packets, responses, and runs
roles.configuration_authority: canonical Suggestions provider selection and adapter-specific definition

roles.owner: Brain inference transport; prompts and decisions remain consumer-owned
roles.health_owner: Brain health composition through the injected InferenceClient
roles.errors: transport exceptions mapped by each consuming domain
roles.cache_owner: provider model residency only; Oracle owns no inference result cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical brain inference role and immutable runtime snapshot

roles.health_owner: Brain speech health
roles.errors: typed STT provider status and transcription errors mapped at speech edge
roles.cache_owner: Fast-Whisper process/model residency; no transcript cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical brain STT provider selection and typed provider settings

roles.health_owner: Brain speech health
roles.errors: typed TTS provider status and synthesis errors mapped at speech edge
roles.cache_owner: TTS domain clip cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical brain TTS provider selection and typed provider settings

roles.owner: satellite runtime and Brain control client
roles.health_owner: satellite control health and Brain playback diagnostics
roles.errors: typed control-plane failure primitives
roles.cache_owner: satellite playback authority and bounded Brain command cache
roles.configuration_authority: canonical playback-target registry and satellite credentials
